title: One decode, many views

definition.title: One decode, many views
definition.source_excerpt: Decode one source once and fan the same timestamped frame to synchronized crops, detail views and bounded analysis consumers. Separate decode reuse from zero-copy claims and release slow consumers promptly.
definition.impact_basis: Potentially removes substantial work from an eligible playback, seek, preparation, retention or repeated interaction. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Trace the precise owner, generation, reset/flush/commit or allocation being changed. Reproduce the present behavior before removing any guard.
definition.minimum_probe: One short action trace through existing code with the candidate disabled/enabled; include the specific seek, cancellation or replacement transition it can affect.
definition.initial_screen: Trace the precise owner, generation, reset/flush/commit or allocation being changed. Reproduce the present behavior before removing any guard. One short action trace through existing code with the candidate disabled/enabled; include the specific seek, cancellation or replacement transition it can affect.
definition.primary_metric: User-visible operation latency, duplicated work or peak/steady live resource ownership; not object counts alone.
definition.scope_contract: Actual output identity and timeline, surviving consumers, committed generations and cleanup; candidate execution must be visible.
definition.negative_control: Cancel or replace a source at the changed boundary and delay a stale callback/consumer; reject late publication and premature reuse.
definition.stop_boundary: At the first need for a cross-backend ownership redesign, record DEFER_SETUP. Do not remove a semantically required reset or increase a timeout to hide a failure.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Relevant existing runtime/owner only. Do not require every other backend to pass before this independent screen.
definition.reopen_condition: A new applicable workload, resolved prerequisite, better independent oracle, or materially different bounded implementation changes the recorded decision.
